facts.claim: The server is the npm package @modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem, started with npx -y, allowed directories as trailing arguments; npm latest is 1.0.0 (published 2026-10-11).
facts.evidence: README: npx -y @modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem /Users/username/Desktop /path/to/other/allowed/dir; registry dist-tags latest = 1.0.0, repository modelcontextprotocol/servers.

facts.claim: npx implies Node.js; the package ships a node bin (dist/index.js).
facts.evidence: bin: mcp-server-filesystem -> dist/index.js; README launches it with npx.

facts.claim: Allowed directories come from command-line args or MCP roots; roots replace the command-line directories; with neither the server exits.
facts.evidence: Set via command-line arguments (args) or MCP Roots.

facts.claim: Read-only tools: read_text_file, read_media_file, read_multiple_files, list_directory, list_directory_with_sizes, directory_tree, search_files, get_file_info, list_allowed_directories (no input).
Changing tools: write_file (overwrites), edit_file (dryRun supported), create_directory, move_file (deletes source).
facts.evidence: write_file is marked destructive; move_file deletes the source.

facts.claim: The repository is maintained by the MCP steering group; Filesystem is listed as a current (not archived) reference server, described as reference implementations not production-ready.
facts.evidence: Filesystem listed among current reference servers.

facts.claim: npm versioning changed from date-style (e.g. 2026.8.31) to semver 1.0.0 on 2026-10-11.

choices.because: the official server is an npm package run with npx; no hosted endpoint exists

choices.decision: directory is a connect.param with no default
choices.because: the allowed folder is the access grant and only the user may choose it

choices.decision: consent on write_file, edit_file, create_directory, move_file
choices.because: these change or remove user files; write_file overwrites and move_file deletes its source
